_note: Universal inference contract. Columns: inference (OS-independent question), shape, windows-collector (today), mac-probe (TBD candidate for the Mac agent), collectorId (must exist in COLLECTORS), green_when.

inferences.windows-collector: GetSystemPowerStatus ACLineStatus (one Win32 call per tick) + as-of time + transition events
GetSystemPowerStatus BatteryLifePercent (numeric whenever a battery exists; null with reason no-battery only when the platform reports none)
Processor Information % Processor Performance, % Performance Limit, Performance Limit Flags; Thermal Zone Throttle Reasons (legacy % of Maximum Frequency kept with a confound note)
inferences.mac-probe: powermetrics thermal pressure / sysctl machdep cpu throttle
inferences.green_when: perfPct present (can exceed 100); limit present; reasons present or null-with-reason

docker ps + vmmem + wsl -l -v
